description: This Java class implements the ShardRegion.MessageExtractor interface from Akka, responsible for extracting entity IDs, messages, and shard IDs in a sharded cluster environment. It utilizes custom mapping strategies to parse and route messages across cluster nodes.

classes.name: ShardRegionExtractor
classes.description: Implements message routing and shard ID assignment for Akka cluster sharding, using customizable mapping strategies to handle different message types.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Factory method to create a ShardRegionExtractor using ActorSystem to load mapping strategies.

methods.name: entityId
methods.description: Extracts the entity ID from various message formats for routing.

methods.name: entityMessage
methods.description: Converts incoming messages into internal representations, handling JSON and envelope types.

methods.name: shardId
methods.description: Computes a shard ID based on the entity ID's hash code.

methods.name: getInactiveShardIds
methods.description: Returns a set of shard IDs that are currently inactive based on active shard ID collection.

methods.name: createJsonifiableFrom
methods.description: Creates a Jsonifiable object from a ShardedMessageEnvelope using loaded mapping strategies.
